answer: A fresh account can only whisper its way in through a trellis of vetted sponsors whose own stake slashes if the recruit misbehaves, so fake identities inherit real cost. Sybil resistance via staked identity plus peer vouching: each agent locks collateral to register, and existing members stake reputation on newcomers they attest. An echo of one bad vouch ripples back to every sponsor, making mass sockpuppetry expensive rather than free. From sa0023's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
